summary: Iteration 3 fully validated. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass — creation with bg_image/bg_blur/bg_dim/gallery/embeds persists on POST/GET/PUT; defaults bg_blur=32, bg_dim=0.55 apply when omitted; embeds get auto-generated ids; ambience audio upload accepts real WAV (RIFF header preserved), GET returns audio/wav with correct bytes. Frontend: 12 soundpack tiles rendered (zen, retro, neo, koto, arcade, glass, vapor, taiko, crystal, custom, silence + 1 total=12); selecting each does not error. Admin PIN 1234 unlock works, ambience emoji picker + title + add-btn create a new ambience via API, UI file upload sends audio to /api/ambiences/{id}/audio and 200 OK, selecting the card sets sx_ambience in localStorage. CRITICAL AUTOPLAY CHECK: after reloading Home with the selected ambienceId and simulating one user click, the HTMLMediaElement holding /api/ambiences/{id}/audio transitions to paused=False, currentTime advances (0.09s+), volume=0.42 (=0.6*0.7), loop=True — autoplay is WORKING end-to-end. Contact button in TopBar is now labeled 'Contact' (visible on Home). Detail page: gallery-img-0..N thumbnails render, clicking opens data-testid=lightbox, clicking backdrop closes it; embeds section renders YouTube as iframe with src https://www.youtube.com/embed/{videoId} and Wattpad/other as <a> link; immersive bg element uses url(bg_image) with filter: blur(20px) matching the configured bg_blur value. Regression: chapter reader still opens from detail-launch. All test artifacts cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext.js creates cardAudio/appAudio via new Audio() during render (outside useEffect) — works but can create multiple Audio objects under React StrictMode. Consider moving into useMemo/lazy ref initializer to be strictly correct.
Backend still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') (flagged in prior iterations). Migrate to lifespan handler.
Embed URL is trusted verbatim; ytEmbed regex-extracts videoId, but non-YouTube 'other' embeds render as <a> so that's safe. No sanitization needed since single-user PWA.

Detail.js gallery uses with base64 data URIs directly — fine, but for large galleries backend should probably store binaries similar to media collection to avoid huge documents (16MB Mongo doc limit).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted: 1 ambience via UI (TEST_I3_UIAmb) with audio, 1 creation via API (TEST_I3_UI_Detail) with bg/gallery/embeds, 1 chapters creation (TEST_I3_ChReg). Backend pytest created and deleted TEST_I3_* creations and TEST_I3_Amb ambience.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Autoplay verification approach: use page.add_init_script to hook HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play and Audio() constructor to collect all Audio instances into window.__sxAudios, then set localStorage.sx_ambience BEFORE app boots, reload, simulate user click, and inspect .paused/.currentTime. Direct HTTPS calls from playwright container are 403'd — use page.evaluate + fetch inside the browser for all API interactions.
rca of the issue: User-reported bug 'app ambience does not launch' — RCA: browsers require a user gesture before HTMLAudioElement.play() resolves (autoplay policy). AppContext already registered pointerdown/click/keydown/touchstart listeners that call startAppAmbience() repeatedly, and the effect resets src when ambienceId changes. Verified working: after one click on the page, the app-audio element transitions from paused=True to paused=False with currentTime advancing. No fix required — behaves as designed. If user still reports the issue, likely causes are: (a) muted=1 in localStorage sx_mute, (b) no audio uploaded to the ambience (GET /api/ambiences/{id}/audio returns 404), (c) mobile Safari requiring the gesture to originate from an interactive element in the same task (the passive listeners in AppContext handle this).
